summary: Frontend-only Playwright test of the new sidebar navigation. Logged in as owner@nedtech.media at /auth/login, verified all 10 sidebar links visible with correct data-testids, navigated through every link and confirmed correct route + page-level data-testid + updated page-title. Verified active-state highlighting (bg-accent on active item only). Verified responsive behavior at 375x812: desktop sidebar hidden, hamburger visible, drawer opens/closes on link click and backdrop click. Regression items (user-name, workspace-name, theme toggle, logout) all pass.

issues: Recharts console warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - a chart container has zero dimensions on initial render. Cosmetic (warning only), but should be fixed by setting minWidth/minHeight or aspect on the ResponsiveContainer.

action_items: Optional: fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer zero-dimension warning on Dashboard by adding minHeight/minWidth or an explicit height.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx: mobile drawer overlay uses classNames for click target - consider giving it a data-testid (e.g., 'mobile-sidebar-backdrop') for more robust testing.
AppShell adds pt-14 on mobile for the fixed top bar; good, but ensure page-header spacing on mobile does not get clipped on very small heights.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar navigation with 10 links (Dashboard, Clients, Sales Pipeline, Tasks, Finance, Products & Services, Employees, AI Assistant, Billing, Settings) is fully functional on desktop and mobile. Login flow works. Auth-guarded routes work. Backend was previously validated 28/28 in iteration_3.
rca of the issue: N/A - original bug (sidebar hidden on <md breakpoints) is fixed by adding a mobile top bar + hamburger drawer while retaining desktop sidebar. Verified visually and via testids.
